correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive fan calculation in verify_prism.py reconstructs all twelve facets and 135 faces, verifies the full edge-difference lattice, finds fifteen maximal nonsmooth two-faces, classifies them as twelve primitive triangles and three primitive parallelograms, and certifies the fifteen rank-three cones have primitive (1,1,-1,-1) relation with all three-ray minors saturated. The standard toric orbit-cone dictionary and Ohsugi-Hibi odd-cycle criterion then imply the theorem over arbitrary algebraically closed fields. The program is finite exhaustive, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: The triangular prism is the smallest canonical graph containing two vertex-disjoint odd triangles joined by edges, hence a motivated normal-graph-edge variety where the global smoothness problem is nontrivial. Complete maximal singular-orbit geometry, degree of their reduced union, distinction of plane/Segre components and uniform conifold transverse models give structural information beyond routine nonsmoothness or face counts, even though the problem is finite.
